notes.title: Patch Fixing
notes.notes:
I was made aware of the introduction cutscene not playing upon pressing play and the camera not moving around on mouse. Although I have managed to fix this it has come at the unfortunate loss of controller support. Since I added controller support the game has started to have bugs (since there weren't any after playtesting). If there are anymore bugs please review, or email me at thomas.galliers@gmail.com so we can make this game as smooth as possible.

Thanks,
Thomas

notes.title: Further Optimisation Update
notes.notes: Hopefully with these few changes on high mode the game will run at atleast 30 frames for people to enjoy the game at the best quality

notes.title: Testing Patch Fix
notes.notes: As I can't test this off Steam I'm making sure the patch works

notes.title: Another Patch
notes.notes: So when playtesting the game on Unreal Engine and Steam everything worked fine but after release the game seems to run poorly and drop frames, during this time I've set the default settings to low. I will be trying to fix this issue as soon as possible to get the game looking and running better. Thank you for your patience

notes.title: Patch (added a few screen resolution changes and 2 quality settings)
notes.notes: You can now change your screen resolution and the quality of the game between low and high

notes.title: Patch
notes.notes: I have fixed the issue with the camera and first cutscene not playing after clicking start. Thank you for your patience and hopefully the game can be enjoyed now:)

notes.title: Release Bug
notes.notes: I am aware of a bug in the game where you need to hold down a mouse button to look around. Unfortunately this was not happening on my final playtest so I'm currently working on a fix. Sorry for the inconvinience for the people who have played it. Working on a fix now
